# Support

## Getting Help

Need help with _codex_? Here are your options:

### Documentation
- **Getting Started**: [`NEWCOMER_GUIDE.md`](../NEWCOMER_GUIDE.md)
- **Architecture**: [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)
- **API Reference**: [`docs/api/`](../docs/api/)
- **Contributing**: [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md)

### Community & Questions
- **GitHub Discussions**: [Aries-Serpent/_codex_/discussions](https://github.com/Aries-Serpent/_codex_/discussions)
  - Q&A, feature discussions, and community support
- **Search existing issues**: Check if your question has been answered
- **Documentation search**: Use the [Search Index](../README.md#-search-index) in README

### Reporting Issues
- **Bug reports**: Use the [Bug Report template](.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml)
- **Feature requests**: Use the [Feature Request template](.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.yml)
- **Security issues**: See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) - **DO NOT** open public issues for vulnerabilities

### SLA Expectations (Internal Consumers)
- **P1 (Critical/High Severity)**: ≤ 4 hours triage
- **P2 (Medium Severity)**: ≤ 2 business days triage  
- **P3 (Low Severity)**: Best effort

### Response Times (Open Source Contributors)
- **Bug reports**: Best effort, typically within 1 week
- **Feature requests**: Reviewed in triage meetings
- **Pull requests**: Initial review within 1 week for active branches

### What NOT to Do
- Don't open issues for general questions (use Discussions instead)
- Don't submit security vulnerabilities as public issues
- Don't ping maintainers directly unless explicitly requested

### Maintainer Contact
For urgent issues or escalation:
- **General**: Open a discussion or issue with appropriate labels
- **Security**: security@aries-serpent.dev (see [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md))
- **Governance**: See [GOVERNANCE.md](../GOVERNANCE.md) for decision-making process

---

**Thank you for using _codex_!** We appreciate your patience and contributions to the community.
